gen-zen-dots-gf-solway: Friendly and techy up top, Zen Dots gives every letter plenty of space to itself, while Solway below is a bookish serif of flat, stencil-like strokes. Display meets text here.
gen-zen-dots-gf-yuji-boku: Zen Dots has a spacious, techy friendliness, with shapes that stay generous at every weight. And Yuji Boku, a dignified text serif, holds each stroke like drawn cable.
gen-zen-dots-nunito-sans: Zen Dots leads with room around every letter, playful and a bit techy. Nunito Sans follows with soft, open-mouthed curves in the small letters, so the display face feels gentler and more approachable beside it.
gen-almendra-display-fs-erode: Almendra Display has ornate, literary letters that never seem to pinch shut, with a pronounced x-height. And Erode, a classic serif, keeps a tall middle band and gently ebbing strokes beneath it.
gen-almendra-display-gf-esteban: Esteban reads refined and classic, its thin parts only slightly slimmer than the stems and its e wide open. Almendra Display above it brings ornate, literary letters, so the serif body supplies the quiet.
gen-almendra-display-gf-faustina: Classic and authoritative, Faustina is a serif whose bowls thin gracefully and whose c opens like a pair of pliers. Almendra Display adds ornate flourish above it.
gen-almendra-display-gf-halant: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, with letters that never pinch shut. But Halant, a text serif with a towering x-height and a faint thick-thin shift, would carry a long page with traditional authority.
gen-almendra-display-gf-hedvig-letters-s: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters with a pronounced x-height. Hedvig Letters Serif, a classic serif, follows with open-ended curves and a sturdy lowercase, so the body can sit comfortably a size or two smaller.
gen-almendra-display-gf-lisu-bosa: Almendra Display sounds ornate and literary. It does its best work with expressive shapes up top, while Lisu Bosa, a classic serif with spilling counters and sturdy lowercase, handles the steady reading below.
gen-almendra-display-gf-marcellus-sc: Ornate meets stately: Almendra Display lays out literary, never-pinching letters, while Marcellus SC, a classic serif, answers with gently modulated strokes and cast-iron stature. Each plays its own part.
